content: {"question":"If I move from GitLab LTD (UK) to GitLab Ireland Ltd, how will my pension contribution rates and employer matching change?","answer":"In the UK you contribute 5% of basic salary with a 4% employer match, while in Ireland you contribute 3% with GitLab matching up to 5% of annual base salary.","evidence_a":"- Team Member: 5% of basic salary\n- GitLab: 4% of basic salary","evidence_b":"- New hires are automatically enrolled under the Aviva plan, with a 3% Employee and Employer contribution\n- Team members can increase their contribution and GitLab matches up to 5% of annual base salary"}
